activity: Very high — sellers post actual notice text and reason codes, often within hours of deactivation
self_promo_rule: Prohibited: posting links to non-Amazon external websites, URLs or hyperlinks, including commercial content such as advertising, promotions or solicitations. Also prohibited: spam, including unsolicited links and the same post copied across threads. Enforcement escalates from an account notification warning, to a temporary posting suspension of 1 to 30 days depending on severity, to permanent removal of posting privileges on repeat violations. Amazon may also unilaterally edit or delete content.
notes: research/channels.md §2.3. HIGHEST-SEVERITY EXECUTION RISK IN THE GTM PLAN (03-gtm-pricing.md §4.2): a single link-bearing reply risks losing the highest-relevance surface in the landscape permanently. NO LINK ANYWHERE, including profile and signature — the unsolicited-links language reads broader than in-post links. Never mention price. Rules read verbatim from Amazon's own guidelines page; re-read before the first post and quarterly thereafter. Access requires a seller account, so true reach is unknowable externally.
